# PDF.js 6.5.438

Unmodified `build/pdf.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.mjs` from Mozilla's `pdfjs-dist` npm package, used for local text extraction from user-selected booking PDFs. Apache-2.0 license included in LICENSE.

Upstream source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/v6.5.438
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz
Distribution integrity: sha512-vg8Pw1x+AFKy4AMDvhuWl5cOYV8d698UoEANoFFhc79hqXDnZQqnOXoxw3HG907WHOg1JYOvLhP756boddFxpA==

The plugin does not render or execute PDF scripts. PDF data stays in the browser; no OCR or external extraction service is used. The original file is not uploaded or stored by the plugin. All imported fields require review before saving the booking.
